_about: Public-domain Ichabod Spencer (1798-1854, pastor of the Second Presbyterian Church, Brooklyn) for the Word Hoard: A Pastor's Sketches, first series (New York: Dodd, 1850) and second series (new edition, Philadelphia, 1853), Discourses on Sacramental Occasions (1861) and his Sermons with a memoir by J. M. Sherwood (Philadelphia: Presbyterian Board, 1885, 2 vols), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 11 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
